m08_alarma_con_presion.sql: SELECT day, TP2, LPS FROM telemetria WHERE LPS = 1 AND TP2 > 6 ORDER BY TP2 DESC LIMIT 10

m09_horas_por_estado.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Motor_current < 1 THEN 'parado' WHEN Motor_current < 5 THEN 'en vacio' ELSE 'en carga' END AS estado, round(count(*) * 10 / 3600.0, 1) AS horas FROM telemetria GROUP BY estado ORDER BY horas DESC

m10_horas_por_mes.sql: SELECT strftime(day, '%Y-%m') AS mes, round(avg(horas), 2) AS horas_de_carga FROM ( SELECT day, count(*) AS lecturas, sum(CASE WHEN DV_eletric = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 10 / 3600.0 AS horas FROM telemetria GROUP BY day ) WHERE lecturas > 0.9 * 8640 GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes

m11_con_with.sql: WITH por_dia AS ( SELECT day, count(*) AS lecturas, sum(CASE WHEN DV_eletric = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 10 / 3600.0 AS horas FROM telemetria GROUP BY day ), dias_completos AS ( SELECT * FROM por_dia WHERE lecturas > 0.9 * 8640 ) SELECT strftime(day, '%Y-%m') AS mes, round(avg(horas), 2) AS horas_de_carga FROM dias_completos GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes

m12_lecturas_por_averia.sql: SELECT a.nr, a.desde, count(t.day) AS lecturas FROM ( SELECT nr, CAST(strptime(start_time, '%-m/%-d/%Y %-H:%M') AS DATE) AS desde, CAST(strptime(end_time, '%-m/%-d/%Y %-H:%M') AS DATE) AS hasta FROM averias ) a LEFT JOIN telemetria t ON t.day BETWEEN a.desde AND a.hasta GROUP BY a.nr, a.desde ORDER BY a.desde

m13_paradas_del_dia.sql: SELECT count(*) AS paradas FROM ( SELECT DV_eletric, lag(DV_eletric) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS antes FROM telemetria WHERE day = DATE '2020-06-05' ) WHERE antes = 1 AND DV_eletric = 0

m15_aceite_por_tramo.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.temperatura < 10 THEN 'a. menos de 10' WHEN c.temperatura < 20 THEN 'b. de 10 a 20' ELSE 'c. mas de 20' END AS calle, count(*) AS horas, round(avg(h.aceite), 1) AS aceite_medio FROM horas h JOIN clima c ON c.hora = h.hora GROUP BY calle ORDER BY calle
